Ergonomically-designed gauging trowel with a soft-grip handle for additional comfort and control whilst working. Features lacquer-coated carbon steel blade and finger guard. End cap allows tamping without damaging bricks. Tapered blade gives trowel greater flexibility making it ideal for small repair jobs. Rounded end ensures easy access to the bottom of a bucket.
